The '''Hi-fex proton torpedo launcher''' was a [[Proton torpedo launcher/Legends|proton torpedo launcher]] manufactured by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]]. It cost 2,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and weighed two [[Metric ton/Legends|metric tons]].
